category_title: Reluctant stayers who use inappropriate language and avoid academic tasks
minimal_context: The student is participating in a whole-class discussion about numeracy applications using an overhead projector.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at the numeracy applications on the overhead projector. Please work through the first question on your worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not on the planet today, mate. Did anyone watch the game last night?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to get through these questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing the work. I'm just not well, cross and cranky.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop talking and look at the slide.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Mate, I don't want to have to get angry the first day. Too much talking anyway, I'm not doing this.
